summary: Situated in this charming, peaceful and highly sought after Eden Valley village, with its thriving community and easy access to Penrith and Appleby, a beautifully presented, deceptively spacious and flexible 3 reception, 3 bedroom cottage with off road parking and low maintenance gardens.
description:
Set within the highly sought-after village of Morland, nestled in the hidden gem that is the Lyvennet Valley, Blossom Hill Cottage enjoys a delightful rural setting while remaining easily accessible to Penrith, Appleby and the M6. With both the Lake District and Yorkshire Dales National Parks within easy reach, the location offers the perfect blend of countryside living and connectivity. Morland itself is a thriving and welcoming community, home to an excellent primary school, the renowned Mill Yard Café and a historic church, and is widely regarded as one of Cumbria’s most desirable villages.

Blossom Hill Cottage occupies an elevated position in the upper part of the village, conveniently placed for the school and enjoying attractive views from the rear towards the Pennines.

Significantly improved in recent years and well maintained by the current owners, the property offers well-presented and thoughtfully arranged accommodation throughout. To the ground floor, an entrance hall/scullery opens into a central hallway with a return staircase to the first floor. The hallway provides access to the kitchen and the lounge, which forms the heart of the home and features a Jøtul wood-burning stove as its focal point. To the front of the property is a separate snug or sitting room, while to the rear a bright sun room provides an excellent connection to the garden.

The first floor offers two generous double bedrooms, together with a third bedroom featuring characterful sloping ceilings, all served by a cleverly designed bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from ample block-paved parking to the side and a low-maintenance enclosed garden, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining.

Properties in Morland are always in strong demand, and viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the location, outlook and quality of accommodation on offer.

Directions From Penrith follow the A6 through Eamont Bridge before turning left, for Cliburn, after approximately half a mile. At the crossroads in Cliburn turn right towards Morland. In Morland itself pass the church on your left and cross over the junction at Hilltop. Carry on up the hill towards the school and Blossom Hill Cottage is on the left hand side.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric, water and drains being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
